description: Free multimedia player with built-in codecs and automatic subtitles.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\ALLPlayer,1.exe" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The 64-bit ALLPlayer executable was not found after extraction.' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\ALLPlayer.exe" -PathType Leaf) { throw 'Refusing to overwrite an existing ALLPlayer.exe.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\allplayer-radio,1.ico" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The selected icon allplayer-radio,1.ico was not found after extraction.' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\allplayer-radio.ico" -PathType Leaf) { throw 'Refusing to overwrite an existing allplayer-radio.ico.' }

$iconBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path $dir 'allplayer-radio.ico')); if ($iconBytes.Length -lt 22 -or $iconBytes[0] -ne 0 -or $iconBytes[1] -ne 0 -or $iconBytes[2] -ne 1 -or $iconBytes[3] -ne 0) { throw 'The extracted allplayer-radio.ico is invalid.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\lib64" -PathType Container)) { throw 'The 64-bit lib64 directory was not found after extraction.' }
